components.name: ADP-12 CubeSat Dispenser Mount
components.desc: Small ring and dispenser mount for CubeSat-class spacecraft.

components.name: ADP-24 Payload Adapter 24 in
components.desc: 610 mm separation ring for small satellites.
components.basis: Class of 24 in clamp-band / Lightband adapters (approximate)

components.name: ADP-37 Payload Adapter 37 in
components.desc: 937 mm separation ring, the standard small-launcher interface.
components.basis: Class of 937 mm (37 in) payload adapters (approximate)

components.name: ADP-66 Payload Adapter 66 in
components.desc: 1666 mm separation ring for large spacecraft.
components.basis: Class of 1666 mm (66 in) payload adapters (approximate)

components.name: BUS-12U CubeSat Bus
components.desc: 12U CubeSat structure. 3 avionics bays, 2 side rows.

components.name: BUS-S Microsat Bus
components.desc: ESPA-class microsatellite bus. 6 bays, 4 side rows.
components.basis: ESPA-class payload is about 0.6 x 0.7 x 1.0 m, up to 180 kg

components.name: BUS-M Small Satellite Bus
components.desc: Mid-size satellite bus. 9 bays, 5 side rows.
components.basis: Class of 300-500 kg small satellite buses

components.name: BUS-L Probe Bus
components.desc: Large science-probe bus. 12 bays, 6 side rows.
components.basis: Class of 1-2 t planetary probe buses

components.name: FC-1 Flight Computer
components.desc: Command and data handling computer.
components.basis: Class of space-qualified LEON-based flight computers

components.name: FC-2 Radiation-hardened Computer
components.desc: Radiation-hardened computer for deep-space missions.

components.name: REC-1 Data Recorder
components.desc: Solid-state recorder that stores science data until downlink.

components.name: IMU-1 Fibre-optic Gyro Unit
components.desc: Measures spacecraft rotation for attitude control.

components.name: BAT-1 Battery 80 Wh
components.desc: Lithium-ion pack for CubeSat-class spacecraft.

components.name: BAT-2 Battery 1 kWh
components.desc: Space-qualified lithium-ion battery.

components.name: SA-0 CubeSat Panel
components.desc: Deployable panel for a 12U CubeSat. One each side.
components.basis: 12U deployable panels give about 14 W each

components.name: SA-1 Microsat Solar Wing
components.desc: Two-panel wing, about 1.4 m2 of triple-junction cells.
components.basis: Triple-junction cells at about 350 W/m2 on the array

components.name: SA-2 Large Solar Wing
components.desc: Three-panel wing, about 3.5 m2 of cells.

components.name: RTG-1 Radioisotope Generator
components.desc: Steady power for the outer solar system. Takes 2 side rows.
components.basis: Class of MMRTG: about 45 kg, 110 W

components.name: TX-S S-band Transceiver
components.desc: Low-rate link for commands and telemetry.

components.name: TX-X X-band Transponder
components.desc: X-band transponder with a 25 W amplifier for deep space.

components.name: ANT-1 Omni Antenna
components.desc: Low-gain antenna with near-full sky coverage.

components.name: ANT-2 Horn Antenna
components.desc: Medium-gain horn on the side of the bus.

components.name: ANT-3 1 m Deployable Dish
components.desc: Dish that unfolds to 1 m across.

components.name: ANT-4 2 m Deployable Dish
components.desc: Dish that unfolds to 2 m for deep-space downlink.
components.basis: Class of 2 m deployable mesh reflectors

components.name: RW-1 Reaction Wheel Set
components.desc: Four wheels that turn and point the spacecraft.
components.basis: Class of small reaction wheel sets

components.name: ST-1 Star Tracker
components.desc: Finds the spacecraft attitude from the stars.

components.name: CAM-1 Imager
components.desc: Visible and near-infrared camera.

components.name: CAM-2 Telescope Camera
components.desc: High-resolution telescope. Takes 2 side rows.

components.name: SPC-1 Spectrometer
components.desc: Measures the chemical makeup of a surface.

components.name: MAG-1 Magnetometer Boom
components.desc: Boom that extends 1.5 m to sense magnetic fields.

components.name: RCS-1 Thruster Module
components.desc: Hydrazine tank and thrusters for small manoeuvres. Takes 2 rows.

components.name: M2020 Perseverance Science Rover
components.desc: Planetary rover with sample caching arm and science suite.

components.name: SEIS & HP3 Geophysical Package
components.desc: Seismometer dome and heat flow mole for planetary interior science.

components.name: TAGSAM & Sample Return Capsule
components.desc: Asteroid regolith sample collector and sealed aerogel return capsule.

components.name: SIS-4 Deep Space Instrument Suite
components.desc: Deep space magnetometry, radar sounder, and imaging spectrometer.

components.name: GPHS-RTG Radioisotope Power System
components.desc: Continuous nuclear power source for Jupiter and Trojan missions.

components.name: UltraFlex High-Efficiency Solar Wings
components.desc: Deployable circular ultra-lightweight solar arrays.
